title: El Nido, from above.
subject: A little more of the Philippines
paragraphs: I’ve added a new moment from the Philippines: a short film from a tour I took in El Nido, with green cliffs, clear water and boats between the islands.
Come along for a 28-second view from above. The full Philippines story is still taking shape; for now, this is another little glimpse of the trip.
